about_the_game:
DESCRIPTION:

Take your old van to the derby track and battle against other drivers in exciting and thrilling races.  Battle for the win and customize your Big, BEAUTIFUL, Van to your preference with your own custom paint scheme. 

DERBY RACE MODE

Customize your own races on different derby race tracks.  Adjust the length of each race and battle against intelligent AI drivers as you improve your driving ability.  Unlock achievements and improve your standing on the leaderboards with every lap that you complete.

COMPETITIVE AI RACING

AI Driver's will react to the race dynamically and realistically. They are completely aware of their surroundings and the race going on around them.  Other drivers will react and make moves on each other,  while they adjust their racing line with the objective of achieving the fastest lap time and moving through the pack.

Skill ranges will vary between each driver,  so you'll notice some drivers struggle and fall off the pace,  while other drivers dominate the race with incredible speed and consistency.

AERODYNAMICS

Vehicles have been fitted with a realistic slipstream and drafting system based on vehicle angle,  speed,  and distance (in relation to each other).  Slipstream and Drafting Effects are calculated with an advanced algorithm to create the most realistic derby racing experience.  

HIGH-DEFINITION QUALITY

Featuring the most recent High Definition rendering capabilities and a focus on quality for every object,  down to the texture.  Texture resolution on track surfaces, walls,  and vehicles are baked at ultra-high resolution for the best visuals and performance.

PARTIAL CONTROLLER SUPPORT

Xbox Controllers are supported and recommended for the greatest driving experience.
